task.description: Design the pure graph structural validator for REQ-028 on branch feature/WF02-REQ028-20260816. Write lib/letflow/design/<module>.md per WF-02 Step 1's procedure.
acceptance_criteria: a graph satisfying all 8 checks returns {valid: true, violations: []}
each of the 8 named checks (CHK-01 through CHK-08) has at least one explicit failing-example test demonstrating its specific violation code is returned, not just a generic invalid-graph test
a graph violating 3 of the 8 checks simultaneously returns all 3 violations in one call, not just the first encountered (Key invariant 5)

a cycle that passes through an EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY or PARALLEL_GATEWAY node is explicitly permitted (not flagged as CYCLE_WITHOUT_GATEWAY), and a self-loop is explicitly rejected, each with its own test
the function signature and its call sites confirm zero Repo/database calls anywhere in its call graph

result.summary: Designed Letflow.Definitions.Graph (lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex, not yet implemented) as a single-file, zero-dependency pure module porting graph.zig's validateGraph(). Defines plain-struct shapes for Node/Edge/Violation/Graph (the DefinitionGraph container itself), the 7-variant PD-05 NodeType atom set, and validate_graph/1's full @spec returning a bare %{valid: boolean(), violations: [Violation.t()]} map (no :ok/:error tuple, justified against graph.zig's own error taxonomy). All 8 named checks (9 violation codes, CHK-01 produces 2) are specified with exact trigger conditions and message templates. CHK-06's DFS cycle detection is fully worked out as an immutable fold/MapSet recursion (dfs_visit/6 with a full @spec), including the precise self-loop-on-gateway corollary the ported algorithm implies. Documents the never-short-circuit composition (fixed 8-check order, unconditional concatenation) and an explicit independence analysis answering the handoff's own sub-question. Flags 3 open questions (attributes typing, missing node-type-validity 9th check tying back to stage-2's Static-typing-gap finding, and who decodes raw jsonb into these structs) rather than silently resolving them. No implementation code included -- struct shapes are Markdown tables, only @type/@spec/@moduledoc-guidance content appears in fenced blocks.
